"""Visual joint-space controller for DexToolBench staples_marker / draw_smile.
Uses only service observations (RGB-D, calibration, proprioception, current goal).
"""
import sys, time, json, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

CAM = ['front', 'side', 'top', 'oblique']
r = Robot(timeout=120)
spec = r.spec()
dt0 = spec['control_dt']
obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAM, include_depth=True, video='frames')
K = np.asarray(obs.meta['cameras']['front']['intrinsic_cv'], float)
Tcw = np.asarray(obs.meta['cameras']['front']['cam2world_gl'], float)

# The front view exposes the palm/finger block against the table. This crop is
# used only to track that visible surface; depth plus camera calibration turns
# its image location into a local Cartesian movement estimate.
TEMPLATE_BOX = (140, 77, 36, 29)  # x, y, width, height
FEATURE_UV = np.array([158., 92.])

def q_now(o=None):
    if o is None: o = obs
    return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], float)[:29]

def feature_point(o, base_uv=FEATURE_UV, template=None, search=18):
    """Track the hand patch in front RGB and convert its center/depth to world."""
    img = o.last['front'].astype(float).mean(axis=2)
    x0,y0,w,h = TEMPLATE_BOX
    if template is None:
        # Default to the current observation around FEATURE_UV.
        template = img[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]
    t = template - template.mean()
    tn = np.linalg.norm(t) + 1e-9
    u0,v0 = map(int, base_uv)
    # The template's center is tied to its initial image offset from FEATURE_UV.
    anchor = np.array([x0+w/2, y0+h/2], float)
    best = (-2., (0,0))
    for dy in range(-search, search+1):
        for dx in range(-search, search+1):
            x=x0+dx; y=y0+dy
            p=img[y:y+h, x:x+w]
            if p.shape != t.shape: continue
            p=p-p.mean(); score=float(np.sum(p*t)/(np.linalg.norm(p)*tn+1e-9))
            if score>best[0]: best=(score,(dx,dy))
    dx,dy=best[1]
    uv=FEATURE_UV+np.array([dx,dy],float)
    u,v=np.rint(uv).astype(int)
    dep=np.asarray(o.depth['front'])[0].astype(float)
    z=float(np.nanmedian(dep[max(0,v-2):v+3,max(0,u-2):u+3]))
    cv=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0], (K[1,2]-v)*z/K[1,1], -z, 1.])
    world=(Tcw@cv)[:3]
    return world, uv, z, best[0]

def step(q, seconds=.8, cams=CAM, note='visual servo step'):
    global obs
    q=np.asarray(q,float)
    n=max(1,round(seconds/dt0)); seconds=n*dt0
    res=r.submit('joint_position', q, dt=seconds, interpolate='linear', cameras=cams,
                 include_depth=True, video='frames', note=note)
    obs=res
    return res

def observe(seconds=0):
    global obs
    if seconds:
        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAM, seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video='frames')
    else:
        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAM, include_depth=True, video='frames')
    return obs

def current_task(): return obs.meta['task']

def calibrate_jacobian(delta=.04, duration=.8):
    """Small safe positive probes of the seven arm joints, restoring each pose."""
    global obs
    qbase=q_now(obs).copy()
    # Restore the last initial probe to the measured pose and let it settle.
    step(qbase, duration=1.0, note='settle at calibration pose')
    observe(.25)
    qbase=q_now(obs).copy()
    p0,uv0,z0,sc0=feature_point(obs)
    # Keep one baseline hand patch template fixed for all small probes.
    x,y,w,h=TEMPLATE_BOX
    im=obs.last['front'].astype(float).mean(axis=2)
    tmpl=im[y:y+h,x:x+w].copy()
    J=np.zeros((3,7)); records=[]
    for j in range(7):
        base_o=obs
        pbase,uvbase,dbase,score0=feature_point(base_o, template=tmpl,search=5)
        qbase=q_now(base_o).copy()
        qt=qbase.copy(); qt[j]+=delta
        probe=step(qt, duration, note=f'calibration joint {j+1} +{delta}')
        p1,uv1,d1,score1=feature_point(probe, template=tmpl,search=20)
        q1=q_now(probe)
        dq=float(q1[j]-qbase[j])
        if abs(dq)<.004:
            dq=float(qt[j]-qbase[j])
        J[:,j]=(p1-pbase)/dq
        records.append({'joint':j+1,'dq':dq,'dxyz':(p1-pbase).tolist(),'uv0':uvbase.tolist(),'uv1':uv1.tolist(),'score':score1,'p1':p1.tolist()})
        print('probe',j+1,'dq',round(dq,4),'dxyz',np.round(p1-pbase,4),'uv',uvbase,'->',uv1,'match',round(score1,3),flush=True)
        # Restore to the actual measured base and allow tracking to settle.
        step(qbase, duration, note=f'restore after calibration joint {j+1}')
        observe(.15)
    print('J world xyz per rad:\n',np.array2string(J,precision=4),flush=True)
    print('calib records',json.dumps(records),flush=True)
    return J, q_now(obs).copy()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print('Connected. task=',current_task(),'control dt=',dt0,'time left=',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    print('Initial q=',np.round(q_now(),4),flush=True)
    print('Start REPL with variables r, obs, step, observe, feature_point, calibrate_jacobian.',flush=True)

"""Visual-only controller for DexToolBench staples_marker / draw_smile.
The controller uses service RGB-D, camera calibration, robot proprioception,
and the exposed current-goal pose. It does not access simulator internals.
"""
import sys, time, json, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

CAM=['front','side','top','oblique']
r=Robot(timeout=120)
spec=r.spec(); dt0=float(spec['control_dt'])
obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAM, include_depth=True, video='frames')
K=np.asarray(obs.meta['cameras']['front']['intrinsic_cv'],float)
Tcw=np.asarray(obs.meta['cameras']['front']['cam2world_gl'],float)
LOW=np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['lower'],float)
HIGH=np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['upper'],float)
J=None; tracker=None

# Palm patch in the front RGB view at the initial arm pose.
START_BOX=(140,77,36,29)

def q_now(o=None):
    if o is None: o=obs
    return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'],float)[:29]

def get_obs(seconds=0):
    global obs
    if seconds:
        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAM,seconds=seconds,include_depth=True,video='frames')
    else:
        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAM,include_depth=True,video='frames')
    return obs

def step(q,seconds=.8,note='visual servo'):
    global obs
    q=np.asarray(q,float)
    seconds=max(dt0,round(seconds/dt0)*dt0)
    res=r.submit('joint_position',q,dt=seconds,interpolate='linear',cameras=CAM,
                 include_depth=True,video='frames',note=note)
    obs=res
    return res

def pix_to_world(u,v,z,o=None):
    if o is None:o=obs
    kk=np.asarray(o.meta['cameras']['front']['intrinsic_cv'],float)
    tt=np.asarray(o.meta['cameras']['front']['cam2world_gl'],float)
    cv=np.array([(u-kk[0,2])*z/kk[0,0],(kk[1,2]-v)*z/kk[1,1],-z,1.])
    return (tt@cv)[:3]

def init_tracker(o=None):
    global tracker
    if o is None:o=obs
    x,y,w,h=START_BOX
    gray=np.asarray(o.last['front'],float).mean(axis=2)
    tracker={'box':START_BOX,'template':gray[y:y+h,x:x+w].copy()}
    return tracker

def track_feature(o=None,search=18):
    """Normalized patch matching followed by calibrated RGB-D backprojection."""
    global tracker
    if o is None:o=obs
    if tracker is None:init_tracker(o)
    x0,y0,w,h=tracker['box']; t=tracker['template']
    gray=np.asarray(o.last['front'],float).mean(axis=2)
    tc=t-t.mean(); tn=np.linalg.norm(tc)+1e-9
    best=(-2.,(0,0))
    for dy in range(-search,search+1):
        for dx in range(-search,search+1):
            x=x0+dx; y=y0+dy
            if x<0 or y<0 or x+w>gray.shape[1] or y+h>gray.shape[0]:continue
            p=gray[y:y+h,x:x+w]; pc=p-p.mean()
            score=float(np.sum(pc*tc)/(np.linalg.norm(pc)*tn+1e-9))
            if score>best[0]:best=(score,(dx,dy))
    score,(dx,dy)=best
    box=(x0+dx,y0+dy,w,h); x,y=box
    u=x+w/2; v=y+h/2
    dep=np.asarray(o.depth['front'])[0].astype(float)
    ui,vi=int(round(u)),int(round(v))
    z=float(np.nanmedian(dep[max(0,vi-2):vi+3,max(0,ui-2):ui+3]))
    pworld=pix_to_world(u,v,z,o)
    # Re-anchor to keep the feature in a local search window and follow its appearance.
    tracker={'box':box,'template':gray[y:y+h,x:x+w].copy()}
    return pworld,np.array([u,v]),z,score

def locate_marker(o=None):
    """Estimate the visible marker center from its dark mesh pixels and depth."""
    if o is None:o=obs
    im=np.asarray(o.last['front']); dep=np.asarray(o.depth['front'])[0].astype(float)
    H,W=dep.shape
    yy,xx=np.indices(dep.shape)
    gray=im.astype(float).mean(axis=2)
    chroma=im.max(axis=2).astype(float)-im.min(axis=2).astype(float)
    mask=(xx>=135)&(xx<=190)&(yy>=127)&(yy<=155)&(gray<155)&(chroma<85)&(dep<1.12)&(dep>.75)
    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    if len(xs)<20: raise RuntimeError(f'marker pixels not found: {len(xs)}')
    pts=[]
    for u,v in zip(xs,ys):
        z=float(dep[v,u]); pts.append(pix_to_world(float(u),float(v),z,o))
    pts=np.asarray(pts)
    return np.median(pts,axis=0),len(xs), (int(xs.min()),int(xs.max()),int(ys.min()),int(ys.max()))

def load_jacobian(path='/app/output/calibration.npz'):
    global J
    J=np.load(path)['J'].astype(float)
    return J

def servo_xyz(target,tol=.018,max_iters=20,max_joint_step=.035,duration=.8,search=18):
    """Damped Cartesian visual servo for the tracked palm feature."""
    global J,obs
    target=np.asarray(target,float)
    if J is None:load_jacobian()
    for it in range(max_iters):
        p,uv,z,score=track_feature(obs,search=search)
        err=target-p; dist=float(np.linalg.norm(err))
        print('servo',it,'p',np.round(p,4),'uv',np.round(uv,1),'target',np.round(target,4),
              'err',np.round(err,4),'norm',round(dist,4),'match',round(score,3),flush=True)
        if dist<tol:return p
        # Damp small singular directions; take only a short step and re-observe.
        lam=.035
        dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+lam*lam*np.eye(3),err)
        scale=min(1.,max_joint_step/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-9))
        dq*=scale
        qb=q_now(obs).copy(); cmd=qb.copy(); cmd[:7]+=dq
        cmd=np.minimum(np.maximum(cmd,LOW),HIGH)
        dqcmd=cmd[:7]-qb[:7]
        prevp=p.copy()
        res=step(cmd,seconds=duration,note=f'cartesian servo iteration {it}')
        qafter=q_now(res).copy(); pafter,uv2,z2,score2=track_feature(res,search=search)
        dqa=qafter[:7]-qb[:7]; dp=pafter-prevp
        # Secant update along the movement just observed.
        den=float(dqa@dqa)
        if den>1e-7:
            J += np.outer(dp-J@dqa,dqa)/den
        print('  command dq',np.round(dqcmd,3),'actual',np.round(dqa,3),'observed dp',np.round(dp,4),
              'post',np.round(pafter,4),'match',round(score2,3),flush=True)
        if score2<.48: print('  warning: hand patch match is weak; stopping for review',flush=True); return pafter
    return track_feature(obs,search=search)[0]

def close_hand():
    """Curl fingertips around the marker from the visually aligned pre-grasp."""
    q=q_now(obs).copy()
    # Flex the four fingers and oppose/curl the thumb. Deltas use joint layout order.
    hand=np.zeros(22)
    # thumb CMC FE, CMC AA, MCP FE, MCP AA, IP
    hand[0:5]=[.80,.75,.65,.05,.70]
    # index MCP FE, AA, PIP, DIP
    hand[5:9]=[.75,.05,.85,.55]
    hand[9:13]=[.75,.02,.85,.55]
    hand[13:17]=[.65,-.02,.75,.45]
    hand[17:22]=[.55,.08,.65,.40,.30]
    q[7:29]=hand
    return step(q,seconds=1.5,note='close hand around staples marker')

def lift(delta_z=.08):
    p,uv,z,score=track_feature(obs)
    return servo_xyz(p+np.array([0.,0.,delta_z]),tol=.018,max_iters=12,max_joint_step=.03,duration=.8)

if __name__=='__main__':
    print('Connected; current task:',obs.meta['task'],'time left:',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    print('Current arm q:',np.round(q_now()[:7],4),flush=True)
    if '--pregrasp' in sys.argv:

        p,uv,z,score=track_feature(obs)
        marker,n,bbox=locate_marker(obs)
        print('tracked palm',p,'pixel',uv,'depth',z,'match',score,flush=True)
        print('marker estimate',marker,'pixels',n,'bbox',bbox,flush=True)
        # Hover roughly 18 cm above the resting tool center before descending.
        pre=marker+np.array([0.,0.,.18])
        servo_xyz(pre,tol=.025,max_iters=12,max_joint_step=.035,duration=.8)
        get_obs()
        print('PREGRASP reached/paused. task=',obs.meta['task'],'q=',np.round(q_now()[:7],3),flush=True)
    if '--grasp' in sys.argv:
        load_jacobian();init_tracker(obs)
        marker,n,bbox=locate_marker(obs)
        grasp_point=marker+np.array([0.,0.,.095])
        print('marker estimate',marker,'grasp palm target',grasp_point,flush=True)
        servo_xyz(grasp_point,tol=.018,max_iters=24,max_joint_step=.025,duration=.8)
        print('at grasp approach; closing hand',flush=True)
